items.title: Aon (AON) Forms Lloyd's Syndicate 1956 For Multi Year Reinsurance Capacity
items.summary: Aon (NYSE:AON) and Blackstone are launching Cortina Syndicate 1956 at Lloyd's to expand multi-year reinsurance capacity. The Cortina vehicle is intended to bring institutional capital directly into the Lloyd's market for longer duration risk transfer. Cortina aims to start underwriting in 2027, subject to final regulatory approval and completion of the setup process at Lloyd's. items.title: What Does Aon (AON) Expanding Client Treaty Capacity To 35% Mean?
items.summary: Aon (NYSE:AON) expanded its Aon Client Treaty facility for 2027, lifting co-insurance capacity to 35% from 28.5%. The enlarged facility is backed by partners including QBE and multiple Lloyd's syndicates, supporting larger committed reinsurance lines. Management describes the expanded Aon Client Treaty as a material investment in broking innovation and risk capital efficiency for clients.
